name: Workbench
duplicates: Old UI (Figma 首页 › 工作台) has default and expanded task lists. Both are now shown in the Workbench prototype. Select language, Log out and the operation-result screen remain outside this study.
flow: tap the section name in the header
tap a task card that has no detail page (Pregnancy check)
tap Toolbox in the bottom bar
tap the Pregnancy check · B31 row

notes.purpose: The first screen of the app: Production tiles, then Health, then Other, for the worker's section across all its units.

elements.name: Production tile
elements.shows: Task · batch · to-do (count due now + a quiet next line) · run (day segments, Day N of N)

states.when: The task has animals due now in the section
states.shows: One line: the count due now and a short word ("10 to watch"); timers and later windows live in the task and on the Schedule

states.when: Part of the due work is past its window
states.shows: The overdue part follows the count on the same line, only it red: "5 now · 2 overdue"; the tile keeps its place

states.when: A multi-day task has nothing due at this moment
states.shows: The next count in grey ("8 tomorrow"), or "None now"; no done state

states.when: The task has run past its planned last day and is still open
states.shows: "6 overdue"; one red run segment per day over (the only colour on the tile); "1 day overdue"

states.when: Everything the task asks for is recorded and the task is still open
states.shows: A quiet tick and "Ready to close" in the count line, the run full; closing stays inside the task

elements.logic: Four fixed slots, each with one kind of message, at the same height in every tile. Short task names (≤15 characters: "Return heat", "Processing"). A tile stays until the task closes.
elements.source: tile() in astra-home-task-card.js; tileModel() in home-astra-prototype.js

elements.name: Health
elements.shows: To treat (count; "N waiting since yesterday" in red, else its units) · Monitoring (count, units) · planned health tasks as tiles
elements.logic: Reactive first: triage marks set on the walk (Treat in place / Hospital pen not yet treated or moved; Monitor). Vaccination plans and treatment orders are tasks, so they use the production tile.

elements.name: Other
elements.shows: One flat list: type icon, what the work is ("Move to Farrowing, Unit 6", "PRRS blood samples"), where the pigs are ("From Units 7, 8"), pigs or pens due on the right
elements.logic: No category headers (there are only a few). Order numbers stay on the task page. Ordered by type. Withdrawal shows in red on the outbound or transfer row it blocks.

rules: Sections in this order: Production, Health, Other. No headline-number strip.
Production is in the order of the sow's cycle (Heat check, Breeding, Return heat, Pregnancy check, Farrowing, Processing, Weaning), then oldest batch first. Overdue is a mark, never a re-sort.
Every open task is listed; there is no "see all". Upcoming work is on the Schedule, not Home.
A closed task leaves the grid for one quiet, muted "N closed today" line that opens the list.

notes.purpose: Pick one unit of the section to narrow every count to that unit.

elements.name: Unit row
elements.shows: Unit 6 · 8 pigs · 4 pens · 2 tasks: the unit's own overview, not one task's state. Rows as on More actions: a unit tile (the Inspect unit card's grid icon), the unit name over its overview, in one white grouped card on the tinted sheet.

states.shows: "N tasks" (singular "1 task")

states.when: No open task instance belongs to the unit
states.shows: "No tasks"; the unit is still listed

states.when: A unit is already chosen
states.shows: An ink check at the right and a 600 title, no fill and no bar (a menu drawer: the tint with one white card)

elements.logic: Count distinct open task instances in this unit, including waiting tasks. Pigs and pens come from units{}; Farrowing sample population uses its own override.
elements.rule: All units of the section are listed with no search (about 15 at most). Choosing a unit narrows counts, not batch time.

states.when: The summary could not be read

elements.logic: Health and Feed are fictional snapshot counts chosen by the `attention` preview (current, clear, health, feed, maintenance, busy, unknown) and are the same in every unit. Maintenance = open maintenance records of the unit.

elements.name: Unit hub · Checked
elements.shows: Checked Yesterday
elements.logic: First segment of units[N].checked (the part before the name). Date and checker are sample data; who checked is dropped.

states.when: No readings but a controllable device

elements.name: Task cards in a unit

elements.logic: The Overview rules re-run on the unit's figures; the footer is replaced by an arrow; tasks without the unit are hidden.

elements.name: Coming up

screens.name: Schedule · this week, Production
screens.zh: 计划 · 本周 · 生产

notes.purpose: The plan for this week, opened from Production's "Schedule ›": done counts on past days, today's list, planned counts, estimates and waiting days.

elements.name: Week board
elements.shows: One line per batch under its task type; a cell per day with that day's count

states.when: A past day
states.shows: How many were recorded (can be 0); light fill

states.when: Today
states.shows: Due today; filled

states.when: A future day with an exact count
states.shows: Outlined count

states.when: A forecast from expected dates (heat, returns, farrowing)
states.shows: Dashed outline, "~8"

states.when: The count depends on today's results
states.shows: Outlined "–"

states.when: A day after the planned end of a task still open
states.shows: Red edge; the batch label turns red

states.when: The task runs but nothing is due that day
The run crosses the week boundary
states.shows: An open edge with an arrow

elements.logic: No "late" state and no grace period: unfinished work carries on, and each past day shows what was done. Counts up to 999 print in full; actual counts from 1,000 shorten to "1.2k", estimates to "~1k". Every row is one line: the gutter holds the shortest label that tells it from its siblings (B31; 14:00; a transfer's batch, B29, or Mixed; PRRS); the full name heads the drawer the row opens. A row is the tap target.

rules: Full screen: ✕ closes back to Home (owner, 2026-10-19); no page header and no bottom bar. The date range is the only text at the top, the week number a small label.
Natural Mon–Sun weeks, paged in the 56px footer: the earlier week is the footer's back slot ("‹ Week 26"), the later week its primary ("Week 28 ›").
Opens filtered to the Home section whose "Schedule ›" was tapped; All, Production, Health and Other are a segment.
All: one card, a band per section (owner chose B, 2026-10-19): a rule, the section icon and its name, with no fill.
No daily total row.

elements.logic: No "late" state and no grace period: unfinished work carries on, and each past day shows what was done. Counts up to 999 print in full; actual counts from 1,000 shorten to "1.2k", estimates to "~1k". Every row is one line: the gutter holds the shortest label that tells it from its siblings (B31; 14:00; a transfer's batch, B29, or Mixed; PRRS); the full name heads the drawer the row opens. A row is the tap target.

elements.name: Legend drawer
elements.shows: Done, Today, Planned, Estimate, Waiting on today, Past its plan, Nothing due
elements.logic: Opens from the ⓘ button (top right).

rules: Full screen: ✕ closes back to Home (owner, 2026-10-19); no page header and no bottom bar. The date range is the only text at the top, the week number a small label.
Natural Mon–Sun weeks, paged in the 56px footer: the earlier week is the footer's back slot ("‹ Week 26"), the later week its primary ("Week 28 ›").
Opens filtered to the Home section whose "Schedule ›" was tapped; All, Production, Health and Other are a segment.
All: one card, a band per section (owner chose B, 2026-10-19): a rule, the section icon and its name, with no fill.
No daily total row.

elements.shows: Task · batch, "Completed · 08:45" or "Ended early · …"
elements.logic: The Overview keeps only a quiet muted "N closed today" line (owner, 2026-10-19); the list lives here. Older receipts live in Records.

notes.purpose: Tapping To treat on the Overview: every pig marked to treat across the section's units, unit by unit (owner, 2026-10-19). Monitoring opens the same list for the pigs marked Monitor.

elements.name: Marked pigs, one group per unit
elements.shows: Unit 7, then its pigs: tag over "Pen B2 · Hospital · 1d", the condition as a plain tag on the right
elements.logic: Row · Animal with tags. No row is coloured: the title already says what to do. "Hospital" or "In place" is how the pig is treated; "1d" marks a pig waiting since yesterday. A pig opens its unit's walk on the Health lens.
